decisions.quote: Both new versions of the Custody Problem yielded results that are consistent with the original findings of Shafir ( Reference Shafir 1993 ).
decisions.location: Section 4 (New (properly normed) versions of the Custody Problem)
decisions.reason: The paper reports two preregistered attribute-norming pilot surveys (Pilot Surveys 1 and 2) and two preregistered replication studies testing updated versions of Shafir's (1993) Custody Problem (Studies 1 and 2). Both Studies 1 and 2 replicate the original choose-reject asymmetry, and the authors' overall verdict in both the abstract ('we compose new versions with updated attributes that fully replicate Shafir’s (1993) original findings') and results section is that the original findings were replicated. Failures using the un-updated 1993 stimuli are cited from earlier papers (Klein et al., 2018; Chandrashekar et al., 2021) or mentioned in passing as reported in another work (Cheek & Shafir, 2024), not studies conducted and reported as part of this paper's replication test.
